summary: George Santayana worked in philosophy. He studied at Boston Latin School, Harvard College, Humboldt University of Berlin, King's College, and Harvard University, completing his doctorate under William James around 1886–1889. He held a post at Harvard from circa 1889 to 1912.
George Shirt worked in linguistics and Indology. He completed a B.A. at the University of Cambridge by 1864 and studied at Church Missionary Society College, Islington, from around 1864 to 1866.

George Thibaut worked in Indology, studying under Albrecht Weber in 1867. He served as Direktor at Queen's College (~1879–1888), Principal at Muir Central College (~1888–1906), and held a post at the University of Calcutta (~1906–1914).

George Watt studied at Aberdeen Grammar School, the University of Aberdeen (~1868–1871), and the University of Glasgow (~1871–1873). He held a post at the University of Calcutta from around 1873 to 1884.

George van Driem is a scholar in linguistics and Tibetology who earned his doctorate at Leiden University (~1983–1987). He held posts at Leiden University (~1989–2009), the University of Bern (2010–2022), and IIT Guwahati (2020).

Georges Dreyfus works in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and philosophy. He studied under Jeffrey Hopkins and several traditional teachers at institutions including the Institute of Buddhist Dialectics and University of Virginia. He held posts at Virginia and Williams College.

Georges-Jean Pinault works in linguistics, Indology, and Iranian and Central Asian studies. He studied at the École Normale Supérieure in 1974, held a post at Blaise Pascal University (~1985–1996), and became a professor at EPHE in 1999.

Georgios T. Halkias specializes in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at the University of Hawaii and University of Oxford under Charles Ramble. He held posts at the Warburg Institute, SOAS, Ruhr University Bochum, and University of Hong Kong.

Gerald James Larson worked in Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. He studied at Union Theological Seminary and Columbia University. He served as professor at the University of California, Santa Barbara (~1970–1995) and Indiana University (~1995–2003).

Gereon Kopf works in religious studies, philosophy, and Buddhist studies. He studied at Temple University and under Yasuo Yuasa. He held posts at J. F. Oberlin University, Nanzan Institute, Luther College (~1997), and the University of Hong Kong.

Gergely Hidas works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He earned his doctorate at the University of Oxford and Balliol College under Alexis Sanderson (2002–2008), later holding posts at Eötvös Loránd University (2007–2014) and the British Museum (2014).

Gerhard Oberhammer worked in Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. He studied at Innsbruck, Paris, and under Erich Frauwallner and V. Raghavan. He held posts at Utrecht University (1961–1964) and succeeded Frauwallner as professor at the University of Vienna in 1964.

Geshe Gendun Lodro was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar. He studied at Drepung Gomang Dratsang under Ngawang Lekden, later serving on its faculty. He also held posts at the University of Hamburg (1967–1979) and the University of Virginia (~1979).
Geshe Karma Sonam is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology who held posts at Sera Monastery and Gyume Tantric College.

Geshe Lhundub Sopa worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Ganden Chokhor and Sera Jey monasteries under several teachers, founded Deer Park Buddhist Center, and served as assistant professor at the University of Wisconsin-Madison (1967–1985).
Geshe Lobsang Tenzin is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He held a post at Sera Monastery and served as abbot at Gyume Tantric College.

Geshe Lobsang Tharchin was a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Sera Monastery from around 1938 to 1953, earning the Lharampa Geshe degree, and at Gyume Tantric College from around 1953 to 1959.
Geshe Lobsang Tsering is a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Geshe Lhundub Sopa. He served as Abbot at Sera Monastery.
Geshe Losang Chödar works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He held posts at the Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies and served as a Tibetan editor at the Institute of Tibetan Classics.
Geshe Ngawang Nyima was a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He served at Drepung Monastery, Leiden University (1960–1969), and was Abbot at Drepung Gomang Monastery from circa 1969 to 1978.
